0022600180.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, 3-1 at home, 1-2 on the road) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home) for the Cavaliers' eighth game of the season. Cleveland sits 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, and 5th in the East, and it enters on a one-game losing streak, while Oklahoma City, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, is riding a one-game winning streak. The Cavaliers trail 0-1 this season after losing 117-112 in Cleveland on November 2, and they went 0-2 against the Thunder in 2025-26. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), both listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), all listed as out.
